4–6 hours (lots of travelling; Inkwing and Sir Leonard have a 2 h cooldown)

A monster has escaped from Professor {npc:Phillip}'s book in Carlin, and in Edron book pages are acting as portals for ink creatures. Kill the {creature:Inkwing}, recover the Illuminated Book Pages for {npc:Wyrdin} and, when your familiar gets pulled into a book, enter the {wiki:Book World|Book World}, cross the four chapters and defeat {creature:Sir Leonard} to rescue it. You receive the Illuminator base outfit, your familiar's figurine, both parts of the {item:Painting of Thais}, the achievement **Power of Words** and access to the Book World's hunting places and shortcuts.

Level **200** and your vocation's {wiki:Summon Familiar|Summon Familiar} spell ({spell:Summon Knight Familiar}, {spell:Summon Paladin Familiar}, {spell:Summon Druid Familiar}, {spell:Summon Sorcerer Familiar} or {spell:Summon Monk Familiar}).
Monks: 1 {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment} (from {wiki:The Way of the Monk Quest} or bought from {npc:Enpa-Deia Pema}).
Paladins and Sorcerers don't need to bring anything at the start: the vocation item is obtained during the quest (Paladins in Thais, Sorcerers in Kazordoon).
For Monks to get to {wiki:Blue Valley}: an {item:Adventurer's Stone} (ask a temple NPC for it with {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}).
Sorcerers: to pick up the Phoenix Feather Quill in Kazordoon; also useful in the Inkwing's lair
Knights only (sold by Willard, in Edron)
Knights only (sold by Thomas, in Edron, 10 gp)
Druids only (daily respawn at Donald McRonald's farm, in Thais)
Druids only (sold by Luna, in Edron, 21 gp)
Monks only (you must be wearing it in Blue Valley)
given by Wyrdin; it must be in your inventory for you to enter the Book World during the quest
Health and mana potions: there are two bosses ({creature:Inkwing} and {creature:Sir Leonard}) and four level 200+ hunting areas.
Optional (painting bosses): the {spell:Levitate} spell, to go up to the roof where the {creature:Wrathful Archivist} painting is, in Yalahar.
the two parts that make up the complete painting

Your familiar's figurine: {item:Thundergiant Figurine} (Sorcerer), {item:Skullfrost Figurine} (Knight), {item:Grovebeast Figurine} (Druid), {item:Emberwing Figurine} (Paladin) or {item:Omniphant Figurine} (Monk)
Access to the {wiki:Book World|Book World} hunting areas and to the shortcuts/teleports between chapters
You can use the Summon Familiar spell again (it is blocked midway through the quest)
Optional: access to the bosses {creature:Tropical Desolator}, {creature:Blight Mariner} and {creature:Wrathful Archivist}, which drop the Illuminator addon items
Book World hunting places (Chapters II, III and IV)
When you finish the quest (final report to {npc:Wyrdin}).
During the quest you need the {item:Magic Bookmark} in your inventory to enter; once you have finished it, you no longer do.
Shortcuts/teleports to the different Book World chapters
Tropical Desolator, Blight Mariner and Wrathful Archivist bosses (paintings in Liberty Bay, Venore and Yalahar)
Only after you finish the quest, when {npc:Wyrdin} tells you about the stolen accessories.
Tropical Desolator and Blight Mariner: 20 h cooldown; the Wrathful Archivist's cooldown is not documented.
The base outfit comes from this quest; the addons use the {item:Scallop Shell} and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} from the painting bosses.
From the moment you use the last page on the book in Edron castle, **you cannot use Summon Familiar** until you finish the quest. Plan your hunts accordingly.

Each vocation has a different mission and only does it in one chapter of the Book World: Druid and Paladin in Chapter II, Knight and Monk in Chapter III, Sorcerer in Chapter IV. If your vocation doesn't appear in a chapter, just pass through it.
Keep **all** quest items (including the {item:Magic Bookmark} and your vocation's preparation item) until the end: the wiki warns that without them you may not be taken to the familiar room.
The {item:Dip Pen with Ink} is the main tool in the Book World: used on a blank space of the parchment floor, it writes the object you need at that spot (torch, bandages, bow, arrow, boat ticket).
{creature:Inkwing} and {creature:Sir Leonard} have a 2-hour cooldown and a maximum fight time of 10 minutes.
1. Pen and Sword — the monster from Phillip's book (Carlin)
It all starts in Carlin, with the teacher Phillip: a creature came out of his book and is on the loose.

Take a boat to **Carlin**: to the harbour captain in your city say {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} charges 110 gp). You arrive at Carlin harbour, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}.

{npc:Phillip} is the teacher at the Carlin school, on Northern Street, in the north-east of the city. Say {key:hi} and {key:book}. He tells you that a monster came out of his book and is on the loose. Accept the challenge when he asks whether you'll deal with it ({key:yes}); he then tells you that the monster left an **ink trail** you can follow.
Leave Carlin and follow the ink stains on the ground. They lead you to the outskirts of the city, far to the **east**, to this point ({coord:32510,31744,7}). Go **down** there.
End of the ink trail (way down)

Down there, follow the corridors **to the end** and step on the **ink puddle** on the floor. That is how you face {creature:Inkwing}, who is in the caves beneath the {wiki:Fields of Glory|Fields of Glory} (floor z=9).

Kill {creature:Inkwing}: it has **12,000 health**, attacks in melee (estimated max damage of 935) and summons 1–2 {creature:Vicious Ink Splash|Vicious Ink Splashes}. It takes more damage from **ice** (110%) and **earth** (105%) and less from **fire** (80%) and physical/holy (95%).
The fight lasts at most **10 minutes** and the boss has a **2-hour** cooldown.

17,500 experience. Possible loot: {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, {item:Book with a Dragon}, {item:Dragon Ham}, {item:Proficiency Catalyst}, potions, gems, {item:Dragon Necklace}, {item:Wand of Dragonbreath}, {item:Dragon Shield}, {item:Blank Imbuement Scroll}, {item:Dragon Slayer}, {item:Wand of Draconia}.

The wiki describes no other exit: go back through the same corridors to where you went down and go up to the surface ({coord:32510,31744,7}); take a {item:Rope} just in case. Then walk back to Carlin, to the **west**.

Go back to {npc:Phillip} and say {key:hi} and {key:book}. He is still worried that there may be more monsters like this one and suggests you talk to {npc:Wyrdin}, in **Edron**, to investigate further.
Wyrdin discovers that the same thing is happening in Edron: book pages are serving as portals to bring in more ink creatures, in the academy and in the castle.
At Carlin harbour, say to {npc:Captain Greyhound} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (110 gp). You arrive at Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

The {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy of Modern Magic} (the seven Ivory Towers) is in the **eastern** part of Edron. {npc:Wyrdin} is in the middle tower (the fourth tower), **1 floor above** the ground floor.

Say {key:hi} and {key:book}. {npc:Wyrdin} tells you that the same thing is happening in the Edron academy and castle: there are book pages working as portals. He asks you to go to the cellars and find **three of these pages** to break the spell.

Go **three floors** below the ground floor of the central tower, to the lowest floor (z=10, the Elemental Spheres room), and go through the quest door to the **east**. On the other side there is a hunting area on the same floor, with {creature:Cinder Wyrmling|Cinder Wyrmlings} and {creature:Shell Drake|Shell Drakes}; the three pages are hidden in objects in that area.
Go prepared to fight Cinder Wyrmlings and Shell Drakes while you look for the pages.
Lowest floor of the central tower (z=10)
Use the **dead tree** at this point: you receive the {item:Illuminated Book Page (A)}.
Use the **cut tree stump** at this point: you receive the {item:Illuminated Book Page (B)}.
Use the **mushrooms** at this point: you receive the {item:Illuminated Book Page (C)}.

With the three pages in your backpack, go back **west** through the quest door to the central tower and go up the stairs to {npc:Wyrdin}'s floor (1 floor above the ground floor, i.e. 4 floors above the floor with the pages).

Say {key:hi} and {key:book}. {npc:Wyrdin} tells you that the counter-spell for the **two pages from the academy books** worked, but he needs more time to study the third one. He asks you to return those two pages to their books.
Go up **1 floor above** Wyrdin, in the central tower, and use one of the two academy pages on the book at this point (the image shows page A being returned). If it doesn't work, try the other one.
Return the other page — southernmost tower
Go to the **southernmost** tower and go up to **3 floors above** Wyrdin's floor. Use the remaining page there (the image shows page B being returned).
Go down to {npc:Wyrdin} and say {key:hi} and {key:book}.
Go to the Edron castle library
You are left with the third page, the castle one. Go to **Edron castle**, north-west of the Ivory Towers, where {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} is. The library is to the **west** of him.
After the next step **you can no longer use Summon Familiar** until you complete the quest.
Use the last page on the book
Use the {item:Illuminated Book Page (C)} on the library book. Claws come out of the pages and pull your {wiki:Familiars|familiar} into the book.
3. Prepare to enter the Book World (by vocation)
From here on the requirements depend on your vocation. Do only your vocation's preparation and go back to Wyrdin.

Go back to {npc:Wyrdin} and say {key:hi} and {key:book}. He apologises for the spell's unexpected effect and tells you that you can save your familiar by **entering the book**, but first you must prepare according to your vocation.
A sacred text: {item:The Sacred Writings of Getema}
Red and blue pigment: {item:Jar of Red Colour} and {item:Jar of Blue Colour}
Meditate in a high place while wearing the {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment}
Knight: buy the Sword and the Inkwell

Buy a {item:Sword} from {npc:Willard}, in the **eastern** part of Edron castle (1 floor above the ground floor), and an {item:Inkwell} from {npc:Thomas}, in the bookshop in the **western** tower of the Ivory Towers, 3 floors above the ground floor (10 gp). Use the inkwell on the sword (or the sword on the inkwell): you receive the {item:Ink-Coated Sword}.
At Edron harbour say to {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (160 gp). You arrive at Thais harbour, next to {npc:Captain Bluebear}.
Go to the **Thais temple** and talk to {npc:Quentin}: say {key:hi} and {key:Getema}. He gives you {item:The Sacred Writings of Getema}.
Get The Sacred Writings of Getema
Don't lose this book: Paladins need to have it with them at the end, otherwise they are not taken to the familiar room after the boss.
At Thais harbour say to {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (160 gp). You arrive at Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

You need 1 {item:Sling Herb} and 1 {item:Star Herb}. The **Sling Herb** cannot be bought: it is picked up at daily respawns, such as {wiki:Donald McRonald|Donald McRonald}'s farm in Thais ({coord:32405,32241,7}), Greenshore and {wiki:Green Claw Swamp|Green Claw Swamp}, or obtained as loot (for example from {creature:Carniphila}, {creature:Elf Arcanist}, {creature:Priestess} and {creature:Spit Nettle}). The **Star Herb** is bought from {npc:Luna} for 21 gp, in the **western** tower of the Ivory Towers, 2 floors above the ground floor (it also drops from {creature:Witch|Witches} and {creature:Pixie|Pixies}).

Go up **4 floors** above {npc:Wyrdin}, to {npc:Sinclair}'s laboratory. Use each of the herbs on one of the {item:Suspicious Cauldron|Suspicious Cauldrons} in the room: the herbs turn into a {item:Jar of Blue Colour} and a {item:Jar of Red Colour}.
Jar of Blue Colour and Jar of Red Colour

At Edron harbour say to {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). On {wiki:Cormaya}, the {wiki:Steamship} is **8 floors below** the island, at the end of Cormaya Street: go down there and say to {npc:Gurbasch} {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (160 gp). You arrive at the underground harbour of **Kazordoon**, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
Sorcerer: use the rope near Pydar

{npc:Pydar} is **north of the Kazordoon temple**, past many fire fields (floor z=11). From the Steamship harbour go up through the city to the temple; alternatively use the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagons}, which connect the Steamship to the temple (250 gp licence, sold by {npc:Lokur}). Head north towards Pydar and, at this point, west of him, use a {item:Rope} (or equivalent).
The fire fields on the way to Pydar burn: cross them with full health.
Sorcerer: pick up the Phoenix Feather Quill
Click the **yellow/orange** fire field to the **east**: you receive the {item:Phoenix Feather Quill}. Then use the {item:Rope} to climb back up.

Go back down to the underground harbour of Kazordoon and say to {npc:Brodrosch} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (160 gp). On Cormaya, go up the 8 floors to the surface, go to the island's **northern** harbour and say to {npc:Pemaret} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
Monk: get the Coned Hat of Enlightenment

Monks receive the {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment} when they use the Shrine of Harmony, in Tiquanda, during {wiki:The Way of the Monk Quest}. If you don't have it, you can buy it from {npc:Enpa-Deia Pema}, in Blue Valley, for **70,000 gp**. You must be **wearing** it for the meditation step.

Use an {item:Adventurer's Stone} in any city's temple to go to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild|Adventurers' Guild} (if you don't have one, ask the temple NPC for it: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}). On the guild's **upper floor**, next to the Reward Shrine, use the {wiki:Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere|Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere}: you are teleported to {wiki:Blue Valley}.
Upper floor of the Adventurers' Guild (Reward Shrine and sphere to Blue Valley)
Monk: meditate at the top of Blue Valley
While wearing the {item:Coned Hat of Enlightenment}, go up to the **top floor** of the main building and stand **between the two statues**, at this point.

Go down the stairs of the main building and use the island's {wiki:Guarded Crystal Sphere|Guarded Crystal Sphere}: it takes you back to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild|Adventurers' Guild}. There, step on the guild's exit teleport, which returns you to the temple of the city you came from ({npc:Charos} can change that destination with {key:service}), and take a boat to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
With your preparation done, go back to {npc:Wyrdin} and say {key:hi} and {key:book}. He gives you a {item:Magic Bookmark}, which gives you access to the {wiki:Book World|Book World}.
During the quest the bookmark must be in your inventory for you to enter the Book World. If you lose it, ask Wyrdin for another one with {key:lost bookmark}.
Inside the book, the floor is made of parchment. Here you learn to use the pen to write whatever you need.
With the {item:Magic Bookmark} in your inventory, go back to the library in **Edron castle** (west of {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}) and use the book. You enter the lair of the ink creatures.

Find {npc:Quill (NPC)|Quill} and say {key:hi}. You learn that your familiar was kidnapped by the **crusaders**, creatures that are half knight and half lion, and that their leader, {creature:Sir Leonard}, is holding it prisoner. Quill advises you to get a {item:Dip Pen} so you can write whatever you need on the parchment floor.
Say {key:mission} to Quill. The mission is different for each vocation and is done in a different chapter (see the table).
Make a deer fur brush ({item:Deer Fur Brush})
Learn an archery technique ({item:Painted Bow}, {item:Painted Arrow})
Better understand life and death, with {npc:Death (NPC)|Death}
Light candles in three places to learn a spell that opens sealed doors
Use the **parchment** on the floor to pull a pen out of it: you receive a {item:Dip Pen}.
Use the {item:Dip Pen} on an **ink puddle** or an **ink fountain**: it becomes a {item:Dip Pen with Ink}.
Use the {item:Dip Pen with Ink} on **any blank space** of the parchment: you receive a {item:Painted Torch}.
Keep the Painted Torch: you need it to open the way between chapters (and, if you are a Sorcerer, to light the candles in Chapter IV).
Burn the fire flower and go down
Use the {item:Painted Torch} on the **floor square with the stylised fire flower**: the fire opens a hole. Go down through it to Chapter II.

Here you find {creature:Bramble Wyrmling|Bramble Wyrmlings} and {creature:Hawk Hopper|Hawk Hoppers}. Only Druids and Paladins have a mission in this chapter; the other vocations cross it to the fire flower at the end.
Go to this area and use the {item:Dip Pen with Ink} on a blank space: you receive {item:Painted Bandages}.
Pick three {item:Painted Healing Herbs} at these three spots.
Use the herbs on the {item:Painted Bandages}: you get {item:Saturated Painted Bandages}.
Soak the bandages with the herbs
Use the {item:Saturated Painted Bandages} on the **white deer**, at this point: you receive the {item:Deer Fur Brush}. Quill's mission complete.
Use the bandages and get the Deer Fur Brush
Go to this area and use the {item:Dip Pen with Ink} on a blank space: you receive a {item:Painted Bow}.
Go to this other area and use the {item:Dip Pen with Ink} again: you receive a {item:Painted Arrow}.
Stand on one of the **wax seals** on this floor and use the {item:Painted Bow} on a **target**. Repeat until you have hit it **three times**. Quill's mission complete.
At the end of the quest, to open the familiar's door, you need the Painted Bow and **3 Painted Arrows** in your backpack. If you are missing any, the familiar room has a pen, ink and space to write.
Burn the fire flower and go down
Fight your way through the monsters to the fire flower at this point, burn it with the {item:Painted Torch} and go down to Chapter III.
6. Chapter III — Knight, Monk and the boat

The enemies here are {creature:Lion Hydra|Lion Hydras} and {creature:Bluebeak|Bluebeaks}. The crusaders' leader is not in this chapter yet: the goal is to reach the **boat to the east**. If you have already completed Quill's mission, you can use a **treasure room** as a shortcut to the eastern area; otherwise, take the **north-west** corridor.
Kill **30 {creature:Lion Hydra|Lion Hydras}** in this chapter. Quill's mission complete.

Go to {npc:Death (NPC)|Death} at this point and say {key:hi}. Follow the bold keywords in the conversation and, when he asks what questions you have, talk to him about {key:loss} and {key:acceptance}. Quill's mission complete.
Near the boat, around this point, use the {item:Dip Pen with Ink} on a blank space: you receive a {item:Boat Ticket}. Without it you cannot use the boat.
Take the boat to Chapter IV
With the {item:Boat Ticket}, use the boat to the east to move on to Chapter IV.
7. Chapter IV — Sorcerer, Sir Leonard and the familiar
The last chapter, with {creature:Crusader|Crusaders} and {creature:Headwalker|Headwalkers}. Sorcerers complete Quill's mission here; then everyone faces {creature:Sir Leonard}.
To learn the spell that opens magically sealed doors, light the candles in three places with the {item:Painted Torch}. Start with this one.
Each time you light candles you take **44.15% of your current health** as damage. Heal up before each spot.
Light the candles at this second spot with the {item:Painted Torch}.
You take 44.15% of your current health as damage again.
Light the candles at the third spot with the {item:Painted Torch}. Quill's mission complete.
You take 44.15% of your current health as damage again.
With Quill's mission complete, cross Chapter IV and enter the **teleport** at this point. It takes you to the fight against {creature:Sir Leonard}.

Carry **all the quest items** from the previous stages. Paladins in particular must have {item:The Sacred Writings of Getema}, otherwise they are not taken to the special room after the fight (possibly a bug).

The fight has no special mechanics. {creature:Sir Leonard} has **22,000 health**, attacks in melee and summons up to 5 {creature:Crusader Guardian|Crusader Guardians}. It takes more damage from **ice** (110%) and **energy** (105%) and much less from **death** (70%) and **physical** (90%).
Maximum fight time of **10 minutes**; **2-hour** cooldown.
26,000 experience and the loot in the table
After killing Sir Leonard, leave the room to the **south**. You reach a new room where your familiar is locked behind a sealed door.

Use your vocation's item on the sealed door (see the table). In the room there is a pen stuck in the floor, ink and space to write, so you can make some of these items again there if you are missing them.
Item to use on the door
{item:Painted Bow} (with 3 {item:Painted Arrow|Painted Arrows} in your backpack)
Talk to your familiar: say {key:hi}, follow the bold keywords in the conversation and say {key:saving}. After you save it, you can use the Summon Familiar spell again.
Open the chest in the room and take your familiar's figurine.

Leave the room by clicking the **door** and step into the **teleport** on the floor. Then you have to go back through all the chapters (IV, III, II and I) and leave the Book World to **Edron** (the Book World entrance is the library book in the castle, west of {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}).

Go back to the Ivory Towers and talk to {npc:Wyrdin} one last time ({key:hi}, {key:book}) to finish the quest. You receive the **two parts** of the {item:Painting of Thais}, the {wiki:Illuminator Outfits|Illuminator} base outfit and the achievement **Power of Words**.
2x Painting of Thais, Illuminator outfit (base) and achievement Power of Words
From now on you can use the **shortcuts to the different chapters** of the Book World and hunt in their areas without needing the {item:Magic Bookmark} in your inventory.

These bosses are optional and only become accessible **after you finish the quest**. {npc:Wyrdin} tells you that two accessories were stolen: the {item:Scallop Shell} and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn}. The possible thieves are inside paintings in Liberty Bay, Venore and Yalahar. {creature:Tropical Desolator} and {creature:Blight Mariner} have a **20-hour** cooldown and a maximum fight time of **10 minutes**; the wiki does not state the cooldown of {creature:Wrathful Archivist}. The wiki also does not describe how to leave the painting rooms.

At Edron harbour say to {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (170 gp). In **Liberty Bay**, go to this point (1 floor above the ground, next to the southern harbour) and click the **painting** to enter the {creature:Tropical Desolator}'s room.

It has 20,500 health, attacks in melee and summons 1–2 {creature:Bound Ape|Bound Apes}, {creature:Bound Cave Spider|Bound Cave Spiders} or {creature:Bound Iks Aucar}. Every 10 seconds a random fruit appears that counts down from 5 and explodes in an area: move away and keep the boss away from it.
explodes in a large area and heals the boss for up to 7,000 if it is within range
23,000 experience; it can drop the {item:Scallop Shell} (≈3.5%), which gives the Illuminator **addon 1**. On the first kill it always drops a {item:Proficiency Catalyst}.

At Edron harbour say to {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} (40 gp). You arrive at Venore harbour, next to {npc:Captain Fearless}. Go to this point (3 floors above the ground) and click the **painting** to enter the {creature:Blight Mariner}'s room.

When you enter you first face three {creature:Drowned Deck Hand|Drowned Deck Hands}, while {creature:Blight Mariner} waits on the ship, in the **north-west** corner. Kill the Deck Hands as fast as possible. After 10–15 seconds the Mariner joins the fight: if the Deck Hands are still alive, ignore him and finish them off; then switch to the boss. You have little time to hit him before he goes back to the ship and summons three more Deck Hands. From then on stationary {creature:Blight Spitter|Blight Spitters} also appear, which deal ranged damage and multiply with each cycle: try to keep the Mariner in the **northern** part of the room.
Any damage you deal to the Blight Mariner while the Deck Hands are alive **heals him by 5,000**.
If you attack via the Battle List, sort it by name in descending order: the Drowned Deck Hands are at the top and the Blight Mariner at the bottom.

Travel to **Yalahar** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}): from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear} (200 gp), from Carlin with {npc:Captain Greyhound} (185 gp) or from Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} (275 gp). In Liberty Bay there is also {npc:Captain Max}, on one of the boats **east** of the pier (400 gp), but he only takes you after you start the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}. {npc:Captain Seahorse}, in Edron, does not go to Yalahar. You arrive at Yalahar harbour.

In Yalahar, go to {npc:Soilance}'s house, in the Inner City, north of the bank. Use {spell:Levitate} on the **right-hand side, outside the house**, to go up to the roof, and click the **painting** to enter the {creature:Wrathful Archivist}'s room.

{creature:Wrathful Archivist} is immortal when you enter. After about 15 seconds **blue books** appear in the room: click one and a random mechanic starts. Once you complete it you can hit the boss for about 15 seconds; if he is still alive, blue books appear again and you repeat with another mechanic.
Deactivate the runes by clicking them in this order: **east, west, north**
Lure 3 ghosts onto the purple teleports

Throw each animal's favourite food on the floor and make them walk over it: {item:Cheese} for the rats, bread ({item:Baguette}) for the rabbits and {item:Meat} for the rotworms. If you have no food, go to the far **west** end of the room and use the machine there
24,000 experience; it can drop the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} (≈2%), which gives the Illuminator **addon 2**.

The wiki does not describe the exit from the painting rooms: look for the exit inside the room to get back to where the painting was. From Venore return to Edron with {npc:Captain Fearless} ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 40 gp) and from Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:edron}, 170 gp). From Yalahar: {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat to the left of Karith's, takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); {npc:Karith}, on a boat 1 floor up in the harbour, takes you to Thais (200 gp), Venore (185 gp), Carlin (185 gp) and other cities, but only after you complete the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the In Service of Yalahar Quest. None of them goes to Edron: then take the boat to Edron in Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}, 160 gp), Venore or Liberty Bay.

Use the {item:Scallop Shell} to receive the Illuminator **addon 1** and the {item:Sand-Filled Horn} for **addon 2**. With both addons you receive the achievement **Illuminator**. See the {wiki:Illuminator Outfits Quest|Illuminator Outfits Quest} guide.
Level 200 is required because you need the Summon Familiar spell, which can only be learnt from that level.
If you lose the {item:Magic Bookmark} during the quest, ask {npc:Wyrdin} for another one with {key:lost bookmark}. After you finish the quest you no longer need it to enter the Book World.

In Chapter III of the Book World the nemesis boss {creature:Sir Leopold} ({coord:32536,32521,10}) also appears, on the 23rd of each month, 30 minutes after server save. It is not part of the quest; do not summon familiars against him, because his mitigation increases while they are present.
The {item:Painting of Thais} is two pieces with the same name which, together, make up the complete painting.
